description: This file defines API routes for managing and retrieving spatial 'sponge zone' data, including functions to convert database records to GeoJSON features and endpoints to get zone collections and specific zone details for a web map application. It utilizes FastAPI, interacts with a Supabase database, and returns GeoJSON-compliant data.

classes.name: SpongeZoneCollection
classes.description: A GeoJSON FeatureCollection of sponge zones with metadata.

classes.name: SpongeZoneFeature
classes.description: A GeoJSON Feature representing a sponge zone with spatial and property data.

classes.name: ZoneProperties
classes.description: Properties of a sponge zone, including IDs, scores, and categories.

classes.name: ZoneDetailResponse
classes.description: Response model for detailed zone information.

methods.description: Converts a database record to a GeoJSON Feature representing a sponge zone.

methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve sponge zones as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection, with optional filters.
